description: Election Commission - Mrs. L. K. D. B. M. Gunasekara, Mr. E. K. G. J. Jeevanlal, Mr. M. R. K. Alwis and Mr. D. W. L. Appuhamy were resigned from the Divulapitiya Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette contains multiple notices under Section 10 A(1)(a) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices as members of the Divulapitiya Pradeshiya Sabha due to ceasing to be members of the United National Party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government, making it clearly fall under the Elections category (Type 7).
